---
name: ai-change-review
description: Review a Modules/AI change against its task, research evidence, architecture and tests.
---

Identify the task and expected behaviour first.

Review the diff against:
- task acceptance criteria;
- relevant synthesis/source IDs;
- behavior configuration;
- host-authority boundaries;
- deterministic persona behaviour;
- regression tests.

Do not broaden into unrelated cleanup.

Run focused tests if needed.

Report blockers first and explicitly state whether the task is safe to close.
